title: Symbiosis: The Art of Application and Kernel Cache Cooperation
note: Dynamically splits memory between an application cache and the kernel page cache for LevelDB, RocksDB and WiredTiger. Entirely user-space: modified KV stores plus a Python/simpy offline simulator, and memory budgets are enforced with cgroup v2, which env.md delegates to the user slice. No root, no kernel changes, single node. Strong improvement target - the sizing policy is a small, self-contained algorithm.
